title: 4chan whistleblower: a decade working on crash retrievals

tellings.quote: whistleblower reported that he'd been working on these crash retrievals for like a for a decade or whatever it was uh in the early 2000s, late 90s, and

plain: An anonymous poster on 4chan, an online message board where users don't give their names, claimed to have spent about ten years in the late 1990s and early 2000s working on crash retrievals, meaning the recovery of crashed craft said to be non-human. A guest named Chris Ramsay repeats this to Michels from the poster's thread, saying the man had worked on these retrievals "for like a decade or whatever it was." If true, it would mean such recoveries were a regular job inside some hidden programme.
